def solve():
    # Inputs
    wD = Q(20) / 100          # target debt weight
    wE = 1 - wD               # target equity weight
    KE = Q("12.5")            # required equity return, percent
    FE = Q("5.5")             # flotation cost, percent of gross proceeds
    D = Q(180)                # debt, USD million
    KD = Q("6.25")            # pretax debt cost, percent
    EBITDA = Q(115)           # USD million
    T = Q(29)                 # tax rate, percent

    # Flotation-adjusted equity cost (percent)
    ke_f = KE / (1 - FE / 100)

    # Interest and capped deductible interest (USD million)
    I = D * KD / 100
    cap = Q(30) / 100 * EBITDA
    deductible = min(I, cap)

    # After-tax debt cost (percent)
    atkd = KD * (1 - (T / 100) * (deductible / I))

    # WACC (percent)
    wacc = wE * ke_f + wD * atkd

    return {
        "final": wacc,
        "flotation_adjusted_equity_cost_percent": ke_f,
        "deductible_interest": deductible,
        "after_tax_debt_cost_percent": atkd,
    }
